entries.scope: G3 no-IALMob Id-Vg, Vd=0.1 V, exact SProcess topology, Vg=0--5 V; dominant unresolved interval Vg=0--0.6667 V
entries.observation: The qualified contact-boundary ElectricField HFS fallback reduces the three-point fixed-state median error from 1.04443 dex to 0.0196168 dex. After repairing the constant_field cached-mobility Jacobian, all 31 no-predictor points converge and the worst KCL relative error is 7.96e-6, but the self-consistent P95 current error is 0.432753 dex and the fixed-current equivalent threshold shift is 43.2055 mV. Vg=0.1667--0.6667 V retains a nearly multiplicative Vela/Sentaurus current factor of 2.61--2.73. An eight-combination psi/phin/phip frozen-state audit attributes a median 0.403147 dex, or 2.53015x, amplification to self-consistent state feedback; phin is the dominant single family at all four audited biases. At Vg=0.3333--0.6667 V the fixed Sentaurus-state operator ratio is only 1.046--1.049, while the full self-consistent ratio is 2.606--2.731. The residual hotspots localize to source-side/channel-side electron continuity and Si/SiO2 interface neighborhoods. This is not yet an approved engine floor.
excluded_causes: uniform electrostatic, flatband, or reference-energy offset
electron-density reconstruction from psi and QF
mixed-Voronoi node volume in fixed-state SG replay
barycentric versus truncated negative-cotangent coupling in same-bias reclose
uniform psi or hole-QF state feedback as the subthreshold current-amplitude cause
SRH or Auger recombination magnitude as the electron-continuity hotspot cause
drain-side anomalous couple-over-length edges as the dominant remaining feedback location
WP1.5 low-current KCL and line-search floor
missing contact-boundary ElectricField fallback as the sole remaining cause
constant_field cached-mobility Jacobian mismatch as a physical curve-amplitude cause
open_causes: source-side and channel-side Si/SiO2 electron-continuity boundary or interface semantics
electron-QF edge support and density-averaging semantics that create the localized self-consistent feedback
direct LDMOS AverageBox per-edge coefficients at nodes 3747, 10233, 4492, and 4538; no direct MeasureCoefficients oracle is archived yet
generalized SRH hole-QF reference convention; low impact on current Id-Vg but material for recombination qualification
entries.expires_when: A direct LDMOS AverageBox per-edge oracle plus source-side Si/SiO2 electron-continuity and first-Newton-step audit either closes the phin feedback or proves a mesh-converged engine difference; generalized SRH reference semantics are independently requalified, or the exact mesh/discretization contract changes.
